# Nostalgex

> Nostalgex is a free, open source (MIT) app that turns your own Plex, Jellyfin or Emby media library into 131 live TV channels in 14 bundles, with a retro channel guide. It runs natively on Apple TV (tvOS 18 or later) and in a web browser through the free web tuner. It needs no paid service and nothing installed on your media server. It does not host or supply any media; everything plays from your own server.

Nostalgex is made by Chad Mueller (Muell Haus Inc.). It is not affiliated with Plex, Jellyfin, Emby or Apple, and it is a different product from NostalgiaTV.

## Get it

- [Nostalgex on the App Store (Apple TV)](https://apps.apple.com/app/nostalgex/id6762563534): free, tvOS 18 or later
- [Web tuner](https://www.nostalgex.app/web-tuner): free, runs in a browser; Jellyfin and Emby need an https address, Plex works as is

## Server guides

- [Nostalgex for Plex](https://www.nostalgex.app/plex): sign in with a code at plex.tv/link
- [Nostalgex for Jellyfin](https://www.nostalgex.app/jellyfin): Quick Connect or username and password
- [Nostalgex for Emby](https://www.nostalgex.app/emby): username and password; on the web tuner, Emby connects through the Jellyfin option
